about: One entry per speech model the studio knows about. Facts come from each model's card or code, read on 2026-11-01. Proof comes from voice_proof.json, written by scripts/build_voices_page.py from real renders.

models.label: Kokoro 82M
models.job: A tiny model with 54 built-in voices in eight languages. Runs fine on a CPU.
models.note: af_heart, built in.

models.label: Kokoro 82M (ONNX fp16)
models.job: The same Kokoro as a half-precision ONNX file, for machines without PyTorch.
models.note: af_heart, built in.

models.label: Chatterbox
models.job: Has a built-in default voice and an exaggeration control. Every clip it makes carries Resemble's inaudible watermark.
models.note: Chatterbox's built-in default voice (conds.pt).

models.label: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B CustomVoice
models.job: Nine premium timbres with a style instruction. The card recommends each speaker's native language.
models.note: Ryan, built in.

models.label: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B CustomVoice
models.job: The small build of the same built-in voices.
models.note: Ryan, built in.

models.label: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B VoiceDesign
models.job: Invents a voice from a sentence describing it. No clip needed.
models.voice_default: A warm, calm adult narrator with a steady pace.
models.note: Designed from: a warm, calm adult narrator with a steady pace.

models.label: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B Base
models.job: Speaks in the voice of a clip you give it, with its transcript.
models.note: A Kokoro built-in voice, af_heart, rendered by us as the reference, since this model has no voice of its own. No real person was copied.

models.label: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B Base
models.job: The small build of the same clip-driven model.
models.note: A Kokoro built-in voice, af_heart, rendered by us as the reference, since this model has no voice of its own. No real person was copied.

models.label: VoxCPM2
models.job: Designs a voice from a description in brackets before the text, or follows a clip. Writes 48 kHz.
models.voice_default: A calm adult narrator with a warm, steady voice
models.note: Designed from: a calm adult narrator with a warm, steady voice.

models.label: FireRedTTS3 Instruct
models.job: Designs a voice from a free-form instruction and writes a plan of it first. Also edits existing speech.
models.voice_default: A calm adult narrator with a warm, steady voice and an even pace.
models.note: Designed from: a calm adult narrator with a warm, steady voice and an even pace.

models.label: FireRedTTS3 Base
models.job: Speaks across 24 languages in the voice of a clip you give it.
models.note: A Kokoro built-in voice, af_heart, rendered by us as the reference, since this model has no voice of its own. No real person was copied.

models.label: VibeVoice Large
models.job: Long-form dialogue for up to four speakers from reference clips.

licence.name: MIT
licence.note: Microsoft's card limits it to research use and advises against commercial or real-world use without further testing

models.note: A Kokoro built-in voice, af_heart, rendered by us as the reference, since this model has no voice of its own. No real person was copied.

models.label: VibeVoice 1.5B
models.job: The smaller VibeVoice with the same reference-clip interface.

licence.name: MIT
licence.note: Microsoft's card limits it to research use and advises against commercial or real-world use without further testing

models.note: A Kokoro built-in voice, af_heart, rendered by us as the reference, since this model has no voice of its own. No real person was copied.

models.label: F5-TTS v1
models.job: Flow-matching speech in the voice of a short clip. Light and quick.
models.note: A Kokoro built-in voice, af_heart, rendered by us as the reference, since this model has no voice of its own. No real person was copied.

models.label: Bark
models.job: Generative speech with built-in speaker presets. It can drift from the script, and adds non-speech sounds.
models.note: v2/en_speaker_6, a built-in preset.

models.label: OmniVoice
models.job: Zero-shot speech in over 600 languages, from a clip or a short list of voice attributes.
models.note: Designed from attributes: male, moderate pitch, American accent.

models.label: Phonon 31M
models.job: A very small English model that reads with a default voice latent.
models.note: Its default voice file, shipped with the model.

models.label: Phonon 40M Multilingual
models.job: The multilingual Phonon.
models.note: Its default voice file, shipped with the model.

models.label: Supertonic 3
models.blocked: Three of its four ONNX modules are here. text_encoder.onnx is not, so it can't start.
models.job: On-device ONNX speech with ten built-in voice styles.

licence.name: BigScience OpenRAIL-M
licence.note: Commercial use is allowed under use-based restrictions, which must be passed on

models.note: F1, a built-in style.

models.label: Paradee 8M
models.job: Kokoro distilled to 8 million parameters, with Kokoro's af_heart as its one voice. 35 MB.
models.note: Its one built-in voice.

models.label: LuxTTS
models.job: A small clip-driven model that writes 48 kHz in a few flow steps.
models.note: A Kokoro built-in voice, af_heart, rendered by us as the reference, since this model has no voice of its own. No real person was copied.

models.label: Humaneness Voice Converter
models.job: Says a source recording in another voice. Audio in, audio out. Its card asks for a consenting target.

licence.name: CC BY 4.0
licence.note: The card calls it research voice conversion and asks for a consenting target speaker

models.note: Source and target are both Kokoro built-in voices, rendered by us.

models.label: NeuCodec
models.job: Squeezes speech to 0.8 kbps and rebuilds it at 24 kHz. A codec for speech models, not a voice.
models.note: The Kokoro reading, encoded and decoded.

models.label: RubatoCodec
models.job: A speech codec whose frames flex with timing. Decodes at 44.1 kHz.
models.note: The Kokoro reading, encoded and decoded.

models.label: MossFormer2 SE 48K
models.job: Removes noise from speech at 48 kHz.
models.note: The Kokoro reading with pink noise added at 5 dB, by us.

models.label: MossFormerGAN SE 16K
models.job: Removes noise from speech at 16 kHz.
models.note: The Kokoro reading with pink noise added at 5 dB, by us.

models.label: MossFormer2 SR 48K
models.job: Rebuilds high frequencies in band-limited speech.
models.note: The Kokoro reading cut to 8 kHz sampling, by us.

models.label: AudioSR speech
models.job: Diffusion super-resolution to 48 kHz for speech.
models.note: The Kokoro reading cut to 8 kHz sampling, by us.

models.label: VoxLock
models.job: Keeps the main caller's voice and drops the voices around them. Runs on a CPU.
models.note: Two Kokoro voices mixed by us; af_heart is the one to keep.

models.label: VoxLock fp16
models.job: The same model at half precision.
models.note: Two Kokoro voices mixed by us; af_heart is the one to keep.

models.label: VoxLock fp32
models.job: The benchmarked full-precision build.
models.note: Two Kokoro voices mixed by us; af_heart is the one to keep.

models.label: Ming 3.0 TTS Tiny 9B
models.blocked: This file is Comfy-Org's repack in core ComfyUI's layout. This ComfyUI has no node that reads it, and the pack on this machine wants the original layout, so loading stops at missing tensors.
models.job: Designs a voice from a description, or follows a clip. Does native podcasts for two speakers. Writes 44.1 kHz.
models.voice_default: A calm adult narrator with a warm, steady voice.
models.note: Designed from: a calm adult narrator with a warm, steady voice.

models.label: Step-Audio-EditX
models.job: Edits speech by emotion, style or pace and follows a clip.
models.note: A Kokoro built-in voice, af_heart, rendered by us as the reference, since this model has no voice of its own. No real person was copied.

models.label: faster-distil-whisper large-v3
models.job: The English transcriber that also does this page's word checks.

models.label: faster-whisper large-v3
models.job: The full multilingual Whisper.

models.label: faster-whisper tiny
models.job: The smallest Whisper, in CTranslate2 form.

models.label: Whisper tiny (OpenAI format)
models.job: The tiny.pt some lip-sync tools ship.

models.label: Whisper tiny (safetensors)
models.job: The same tiny model in Transformers format.

models.label: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3
models.job: A fast multilingual transducer.

models.label: Parakeet Ultra
models.job: A post-trained Parakeet TDT v3 with the same architecture.

models.label: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 (NeMo)
models.blocked: The file is here, but NeMo 3.0 in this stack won't import against the installed lhotse and lightning. It needs its own environment.
models.job: The English Parakeet in its NeMo package.

models.label: Nemotron Speech Streaming
models.job: A streaming English transducer.

licence.name: NVIDIA Open Model License
licence.note: Read the licence before commercial use

models.label: Granite Speech 5.0 TurboCTC
models.job: A CTC transcriber, native in Transformers.

models.label: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B
models.job: Transcribes and tags the language.

models.label: Paraformer (Step-Audio tokenizer)
models.job: The Chinese-Cantonese-English transcriber Step-Audio ships.

licence.name: Check the licence
licence.note: The upstream FunASR model licence was not stated on this copy

models.label: SeACo Paraformer (SoulX)
models.job: The Chinese transcriber SoulX-Singer uses. It was given a Kokoro reading in Chinese.

licence.name: Check the licence
licence.note: The upstream FunASR model licence was not stated on this copy

models.label: Zonos v0.1
models.job: Emotion and pitch controls, with a neutral voice when no clip is given. Needs descript/dac_44khz beside it.
models.note: Its unconditioned voice. No clip.

models.label: Zonos v0.1, from a clip
models.job: The same model with its speaker embedding, following a clip you give it.
models.note: A Kokoro built-in voice, af_heart, rendered by us as the reference, since this model has no voice of its own. No real person was copied.

models.label: Maya1
models.job: Voice from a description, with emotion tags. Needs hubertsiuzdak/snac_24khz beside it.
models.voice_default: Realistic male voice in the 30s age with american accent. Normal pitch, warm timbre, conversational pacing.
models.note: Designed from: a man in his 30s, American accent, warm timbre, conversational pacing.

models.label: IndexTTS-2
models.job: Clip-driven speech with emotion and duration control.

licence.name: Bilibili IndexTTS licence
licence.note: Read the licence before commercial use

models.blocked: Only its text model (qwen0.6bemo4-merge) and small feature files are here. The GPT, S2Mel and BigVGAN checkpoints it speaks with are not on this machine.

models.label: XTTS v2
models.job: Clip-driven multilingual speech with built-in studio speakers.
models.blocked: Its main checkpoint, model.pth, is not on this machine. Only the DVAE, mel stats and speaker list landed.

models.label: GLM-TTS
models.job: Clip-driven speech with an RL-tuned model.
models.blocked: The first shard of its language model, model-00001-of-00002.safetensors, is not on this machine, so it can't load.

models.label: VibeVoice-ASR
models.job: Long-form transcription with speakers and times.

licence.name: MIT
licence.note: Microsoft's card limits it to research use

models.blocked: Only shard 8 of 8 is on this machine.

models.label: Bark voice-cloning quantizers
models.job: Six small HuBERT quantizers that turn a clip into Bark's semantic tokens.
models.blocked: No runner yet for these. HuBERT is now available, but they only make sense from a clip through Suno's original pipeline, whose text.pt is missing. The Transformers build of Bark rendered fine without them.

models.label: AV MossFormer2 target speaker
models.job: Picks one speaker from a mix, using video of their face.
models.blocked: It needs video of a real face to work from, so a synthetic-voice sample can't prove it.

models.label: MegaTTS3
models.job: Clip-driven speech with accent control.
models.blocked: ByteDance held back the WaveVAE encoder for security reasons, so a new clip can't be encoded. It only runs from pre-extracted voices, and the ones in the repo are recordings of people, which this page won't copy.
